controls.role: TRAIN saved metadata only plus prospective manifest identity

limits: No model construction, checkpoint payload read, forward, optimizer update, native task, search, patient input, or held-out task execution.
1280 loss forwards plus 80 fixed readout forwards is a larger budget than the original 128 loss forwards; results cannot isolate minibatch variance at matched compute.
The prior measurement cohort is exposed and must not supply tuning evidence or be described as untouched for a successor.
Hard process termination may prevent best-effort partial checkpoint emission; supervised receipt remains authoritative.
review_harness_corrections: First local check used source.patch rather than actual promotion.patch; corrected reviewer path only.
Second local check directly compared immutable tuple containers to serialized JSON lists; corrected reviewer comparison to thawed JSON. Canonical semantic hash check retained.
scope: Source/prospective protocol and saved TRAIN metadata only. Canonical test execution and actual fit remain root-owned.
